query: What was the gross profit margin for last month?

```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(oi.PriceExclTax) AS TotalRevenueExclTax,
    SUM(oi.OriginalProductCost * oi.Quantity) AS TotalCost,
    SUM(oi.PriceExclTax) - SUM(oi.OriginalProductCost * oi.Quantity) AS GrossProfit,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(oi.PriceExclTax) = 0 THEN 0

            ((SUM(oi.PriceExclTax) - SUM(oi.OriginalProductCost * oi.Quantity)) / SUM(oi.PriceExclTax)) * 100,

    AND o.CreatedOnUtc >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01')
    AND o.CreatedOnUtc < DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01');
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        pcm.CategoryId,
        SUM(oi.PriceExclTax) AS GrossSales,
        SUM(oi.Quantity) AS TotalUnitsSold,
        -- Calculate proportional refund amount for items in the category
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN o.PaymentStatusId IN (35, 40) OR o.RefundedAmount > 0 THEN 
                    (o.RefundedAmount * (oi.PriceExclTax / NULLIF(o.OrderSubtotalExclTax, 0)))
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) AS TotalRefundedAmount
    FROM Product_Category_Mapping pcm
    INNER JOIN OrderItem oi ON pcm.ProductId = oi.ProductId
    INNER JOIN `Order` o ON oi.OrderId = o.Id
    WHERE o.Deleted = 0 
      AND o.OrderStatusId <> 40 -- Exclude fully cancelled orders
    GROUP BY pcm.CategoryId
)
SELECT 
    cb.CategoryId,
    cb.CategoryName,
    cb.TotalProducts,
    cb.InStockProducts,
    cb.TotalStockQuantity,
    COALESCE(csr.GrossSales, 0.00) AS GrossSales,
    COALESCE(csr.TotalUnitsSold, 0) AS TotalUnitsSold,
    COALESCE(csr.TotalRefundedAmount, 0.00) AS TotalRefundedAmount,
    
    -- Stock Availability Rate (%)
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN cb.TotalProducts > 0 
            THEN (cb.InStockProducts / cb.TotalProducts) * 100 
            ELSE 0 
        END, 2
    ) AS StockAvailabilityRate,

    -- Refund Rate (%)
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(csr.GrossSales, 0) > 0 
            THEN (COALESCE(csr.TotalRefundedAmount, 0) / csr.GrossSales) * 100 
            ELSE 0 
        END, 2
    ) AS RefundRatePercentage,

    -- Composite Overall Health Score (Scale 0 - 100)
    -- Formula Weights:
    -- 1. Stock Health (40%): Ratio of products currently in stock
    -- 2. Refund Health (40%): Inverse of Refund Rate (Lower refunds = higher score)
    -- 3. Sales Volume Factor (20%): Scaled sales activity
    ROUND(
        (
            -- Stock Score (Max 40 points)
            (CASE WHEN cb.TotalProducts > 0 THEN (cb.InStockProducts / cb.TotalProducts) ELSE 0 END) * 40

            LEAST(20, (COALESCE(csr.TotalUnitsSold, 0) / 5.0))

    ) AS OverallHealthScore
```

query: Forecast next month's total revenue based on historical trends.
baseline_sql:
```sql
WITH MonthlyRevenue AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_FORMAT(CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m-01') AS MonthDate,
        SUM(OrderTotal) AS TotalRevenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m-01')) AS x
    FROM `Order`
    WHERE Deleted = 0 
      AND OrderStatusId = 30 -- Complete
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m-01')
),
Stats AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS n,
        SUM(x) AS sum_x,
        SUM(TotalRevenue) AS sum_y,
        SUM(x * TotalRevenue) AS sum_xy,
        SUM(x * x) AS sum_xx,
        MAX(x) AS max_x,
        MAX(MonthDate) AS last_month
    FROM MonthlyRevenue
),
RegressionComponents AS (
    SELECT 
        max_x + 1 AS next_x,
        last_month,
        (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / NULLIF((n * sum_xx - sum_x * sum_x), 0) AS slope,
        (sum_y - ((n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / NULLIF((n * sum_xx - sum_x * sum_x), 0)) * sum_x) / n AS intercept
    FROM Stats
)
SELECT 
    DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(last_month, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS ForecastMonth,
    ROUND(GREATEST(0, (slope * next_x) + intercept), 2) AS ForecastedTotalRevenue
```

```sql
-- Overall Business Performance Summary KPIs
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.Id) AS Total_Orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.OrderStatusId = 30 THEN o.Id END) AS Completed_Orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.OrderStatusId = 40 THEN o.Id END) AS Cancelled_Orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerId) AS Unique_Purchasing_Customers,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderStatusId != 40 THEN o.OrderTotal ELSE 0 END), 2) AS Gross_Revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderStatusId = 30 AND o.PaymentStatusId = 30 THEN o.OrderTotal ELSE 0 END), 2) AS Net_Completed_Revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN o.OrderStatusId != 40 THEN o.OrderTotal END), 2) AS Average_Order_Value,
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.TotalQuantitySold), 0) AS Total_Units_Sold
FROM 
    `Order` o
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        OrderId, 
        SUM(Quantity) AS TotalQuantitySold
    FROM 
        OrderItem
    GROUP BY 
        OrderId
) oi ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
WHERE 
    o.Deleted = 0;

-- Monthly Business Growth & Revenue Trend
SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m') AS Sales_Month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.Id) AS Total_Orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerId) AS Active_Customers,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderStatusId != 40 THEN o.OrderTotal ELSE 0 END), 2) AS Monthly_Revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN o.OrderStatusId != 40 THEN o.OrderTotal END), 2) AS Monthly_AOV
FROM 
    `Order` o
WHERE 
    o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY 
    DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY 
    Sales_Month DESC;
```

```sql
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
```
